card.title: Tradition Outranks Explanation
card.instruction: Treat inherited customs as meaningful because they have been repeated. Preserve each step and resist every request to explain why it still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we launch the boat, three circuits. Grandad always started at the bow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why three? The tide's right now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He did three every launch. Come round to the bow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already walked round twice carrying the ropes. Can those count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with ropes. Grandad collected those afterwards. Put them back and we'll begin properly.
